changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Editor host pairing requests and team grants (ADR 0166). Nothing writes them yet. A pairing request holds no workspace, team or content; once approved, it names only the approving account. A grant exists only while its account is a member of its team: the team membership's end deletes it.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.host_pairing ( id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT host_pairingPK PRIMARY KEY, code_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, code_challenge VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, host_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, approved_account_id BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_host_pairing_code UNIQUE (code_hash), CONSTRAINT ck_host_pairing_host_kind CHECK (host_kind IN ('FIGJAM', 'FIGMA_DESIGN', 'APOLLON')), CONSTRAINT ck_host_pairing_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')), CONSTRAINT ck_host_pairing_approval CHECK ((status = 'APPROVED') = (approved_account_id IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT sfk_host_pairing_account FOREIGN KEY (approved_account_id) REFERENCES public.account (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_host_pairing_approved_account ON public.host_pairing (approved_account_id); CREATE TABLE public.host_grant ( id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT host_grantPK PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id BIGINT NOT NULL, team_id UUID NOT NULL, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, host_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, revoked_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT uk_host_grant_token UNIQUE (token_hash), CONSTRAINT ck_host_grant_host_kind CHECK (host_kind IN ('FIGJAM', 'FIGMA_DESIGN', 'APOLLON')), -- The team key comes first, so the grant's team and workspace are one pair. CONSTRAINT sfk_host_grant_team FOREIGN KEY (team_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES public.project_team (id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT sfk_host_grant_member FOREIGN KEY (team_id, account_id) REFERENCES public.project_team_member (team_id, account_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_host_grant_account ON public.host_grant (account_id); CREATE INDEX idx_host_grant_member ON public.host_grant (team_id, account_id); CREATE INDEX idx_host_grant_team ON public.host_grant (team_id, workspace_id);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE public.host_grant; DROP TABLE public.host_pairing;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A pairing request names its approving account, not the team that it approved, so the end of any team membership of that account refuses its approved requests (ADR 0166 rule 6). Leaving a team, leaving the workspace, erasure and workspace purge all delete team memberships. A request of another team is refused too, and the host pairs again.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER project_team_member_end_host_pairings AFTER DELETE ON public.project_team_member FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.refuse_host_pairings_of_former_member();
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER project_team_member_end_host_pairings ON public.project_team_member; DROP FUNCTION public.refuse_host_pairings_of_former_member();
